items.reader: The document recommends **not shipping** Ranker v7. The headline +0.78 pt lift applies only to triggered searches, which are 20.5% of control successes. Scaled to overall search, the lift is about +0.16 pt (95% CI about +0.11 to +0.21). That misses the pre-registered +0.5 pt bar, and even the top of the CI falls short. Guardrails show no harm, and the experiment looks valid. Don't ship v7. If the team wants to launch anyway, it has to argue for changing the bar openly at the review, not cite the triggered-only number. Overall Successful Search Rate lift, about **+0.16 percentage points** (CI +0.11 to +0.21), against a **+0.5 pt** bar. The Queries per User drop (−1.04%, p=0.024) was not pre-registered and is one of about 60 metrics and segments, so it is probably chance. The document says it is worth watching. The overall figure is also a scaled estimate, not a direct one, but this doesn't change the call.
